title: Inspect and extend: Remember a watchlist without a service account
objective: Use the real implementation in `Sources/Models.swift` to demonstrate and safely improve store defaults, add/remove operations, and userdefaults reload.
problem: A watchlist is a saved set of identifiers. Follow a toggle from button through the store to UserDefaults and verify persistence using the tests. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `Sources/Models.swift` and the related project files: Sources/Models.swift; Sources/Screens/WatchlistView.swift; Tests/MovieCoreTests.swift.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to store defaults, add/remove operations, and userdefaults reload.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: Local watchlist persistence does not create an account or sync across devices.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: A watchlist is a saved set of identifiers. Follow a toggle from button through the store to UserDefaults and verify persistence using the tests.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `Sources/Models.swift`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
